*Dassanattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 23.26) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Structurally situated within the complex combinatorial system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text pairs the analytical triad pertaining to insight or vision (*dassanattika*) with the foundational triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral].

However, automated text-reuse analysis through DharmaNexus highlights substantial internal textual reuse across the Pali Abhidhamma, recording 113 matching passages distributed across 42 other Pali texts, all within the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus].
